# Vendored third-party files

Pinned copies served from this site so the page makes no third-party CDN or font requests.
SHA-512 values are the SRI hashes published by cdnjs (`https://api.cdnjs.com/libraries/<lib>/<version>?fields=sri`); each downloaded file was recomputed locally and matched. Font files have no published hash, so their SHA-256 is recorded as downloaded on 2026-10-03.
